newsitem.title: USA: Dow industrials choppy, Nasdaq holds steady.
newsitem.headline: Dow industrials choppy, Nasdaq holds steady.

text.p: The Dow industrial average weakened further in afternoon trading on Monday, even as the long bond held steady at a lower yield, but smaller-capitalization stocks fared better.
"This is a strange market," Frank Calta, a trader at Dain Bosworth, said. "It could be a classic group rotation with small-cap stocks coming to the fore while the Dow slips."

The Dow industrial average was off around 40 points at 7291, but breadth on the New York Stock Exchange was positive. Nasdaq was up 0.46 at 1401, while the long bond was unchanged at a 6.91 percent yield. The Russell 2000 was up 1.81 at 383.
